name: What do I need to prepare before cabinet installers arrive?

mainEntity.name: What do I need to prepare before cabinet installers arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparation involves clearing the entire kitchen, emptying all old cabinets, and establishing a safe workspace. Homeowners should pack away dishware and small appliances, clear adjacent hallways for material staging, and protect nearby flooring. If you are keeping existing appliances, disconnect and move them out of the installation zone. Confirm that any electrical rough-ins, plumbing relocations, and drywall repairs are fully inspected and finished before installers arrive to hang boxes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Empty all existing cabinets, clear surrounding pathways for staging, and ensure all electrical, plumbing, and drywall rough-in work is complete.
